## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I'm from China and recently finished my undergraduate studies. I was drawn to MUSA because I realized that urban spatial analytics offers a powerful way to decode complex city phenomena using data. I'm especially interested in how people behave economically in urban spaces — how they move, consume, and interact with the built environment. I haven't settled on a specific career path yet, but I hope to use data to tell stories about cities and inform better decision-making.
